name: Agginares meh Koukia (Artichokes With Fava Beans)
author: Molly O’Neill

ingredients.raw: 8 scallions, white parts and 2 inches of green parts sliced into ½-inch pieces
ingredients.preparation: white parts and 2 inches of green parts sliced into ½-inch pieces

ingredients.raw: 1 ½ teaspoons kosher salt, plus more to taste
8 large artichoke bottoms and stems, outer leaves and choke removed, stems peeled and separated from bottoms
ingredients.preparation: outer leaves and choke removed, stems peeled and separated from bottoms

ingredients.raw: 1 pound dry fava beans, soaked 24 hours in water and peeled
ingredients.preparation: soaked 24 hours in water and peeled

ingredients.raw: 2 carrots, peeled and cut into ¼-inch rounds
ingredients.preparation: peeled and cut into ¼-inch rounds

ingredients.raw: ¼ cup chopped fresh dill leaves

steps.text: Place the onions and scallions in a very large, deep skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes to remove excess moisture. Add the corn oil and 1 ½ teaspoons salt and continue to cook until onions become just translucent, 3 minutes.

Add the artichokes to the pan in an even layer. Add enough water to come of the way up the artichokes. Reduce the heat to a strong simmer, cover and cook for 12 minutes. Turn artichoke pieces over, cover and continue cooking until just barely tender, about 10 minutes more.
Add the beans, carrots and ½the dill. Add water to the level of the beans and continue cooking, covered, until the beans are tender, about 7 minutes more.

Remove from the heat. Gently stir in the lemon juice and season with salt to taste. (Some of the beans will lose shape.) Transfer to a platter, drizzle with the olive oil, garnish with the remaining dill and serve warm.
